blocks.text: BACO, Oriental Mindoro — The barangay council of Pulang Tubig in the Oriental Mindoro town of Buco had formally asked for the immediate suspension of the proposed Alag River Restoration and Dredging Project, including its coastal and marine components, citing serious gaps in the environmental review process and local legal requirements, the Inquirer learned on Tuesday (Sept. 15) In an August 31 letter addressed Environmental Management Bureau MIMAROPA Regional Director Joe Mail Salino, Barangay Captain Gina Magsino asserted that Pulang Tubig sits at the mouth of the Alag River and forms part of the estuarine and coastal ecosystem directly linked to […]...
